```{r}
# imported libraries
inhouse_lib <- parse_library(file_path = system.file("extdata", "CBIO", "PA14_CBIO_Standards.library", package = "MS1Match"),
                                                    ionPolarity = "pos",spectrum_type ="MS1")

                           spectrum_type = "MS",ionPolarity = "POSITIVE")
csu_lib     <-  import_msp_csu(system.file("extdata", "CSUPMF_C8_lib", "CSUPMF_C8_lib.mspLib", package = "MS1Match"))



```

```{r}
# Collect peak counts per library
df_peaks <- tibble(
  Library = rep(c("In-house", "MoNA", "CSU-PMF"), each = 1),
  Counts  = c(
    list(sapply(inhouse_lib, function(x) nrow(x$Peaks))),
    list(sapply(mona_lib, function(x) nrow(x$Peaks))),
    list(sapply(csu_lib, function(x) nrow(x$Peaks)))
  )
) %>%
  unnest_longer(Counts) %>%
  mutate(Library = factor(Library, levels = c("In-house", "MoNA", "CSU-PMF")))

# Compute medians
medians <- df_peaks %>%
  group_by(Library) %>%
  summarise(med = median(Counts))

# X positions for segment lines (tight inside each violin)
segments <- medians %>%
  mutate(
    x = as.numeric(Library),
    x_left  = x - 0.35,
    x_right = x + 0.35
  )

# Color palette for libraries
lib_colors <- c(
  "In-house" = "#1f78b4",
  "MoNA"     = "#33a02c",
  "CSU-PMF"  = "#e31a1c"
)

```


```{r}
p_violin <- ggplot(df_peaks, aes(x = Library, y = Counts, fill = Library)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, color = "black", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.25, size = 1) +

  # median dashed line
  geom_segment(
    data = segments,
    aes(x = x_left, xend = x_right, y = med, yend = med, color = Library),
    linewidth = 1.0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  # Median labels with custom per-library offsets
  geom_text(
    data = medians %>%
      mutate(
        x_num = case_when(
          Library == "In-house" ~ as.numeric(Library) + 0.4,
          Library == "MoNA"     ~ as.numeric(Library) + 0.50,
          Library == "CSU-PMF"  ~ as.numeric(Library) + 0.45
        ),
        y_adj = ifelse(med <= 1, 1.3, med * 1.)
      ),
    aes(x = x_num, y = y_adj,
        label = format(round(med), big.mark = ",")),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 2,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = lib_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = lib_colors) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000),
    labels = c("1", "3", "10", "30", "100", "300", "1000")
  ) +

theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 6),

    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Library",
    y = "Number of peaks"
  )

p_violin
```

```{r}
compare_libraries_3 <- function(lib1, lib2, lib3 = NULL,
                                names = c("Library1", "Library2", "Library3")) {
  # --- helpers ---
  get_field <- function(x, field) if (!is.null(x[[field]])) x[[field]] else NA_character_
  to_utf8 <- function(x) iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")

  normalize_formula <- function(f) {
    f <- trimws(f)
    f <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", f)
    f <- gsub("[+-]+$", "", f)
    f <- gsub("\\s+", "", f)
    f
  }

  extract_info <- function(lib, label) {
    if (length(lib) == 0) return(data.frame())
    df <- data.frame(
      Formula = to_utf8(sapply(lib, function(x) normalize_formula(get_field(x, "Formula")))),
      Name = to_utf8(sapply(lib, function(x) get_field(x, "Name"))),
      Synonyms = to_utf8(sapply(lib, function(x) {
        syn <- unlist(x[grep("^SYNON", names(x), ignore.case = TRUE)])
        if (length(syn) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(unique(syn), collapse = "; ")
      })),
      Source = label,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    # rename columns with library prefix
    names(df)[2:4] <- paste0(names(df)[2:4], "_", label)
    df
  }

  df1 <- extract_info(lib1, names[1])
  df2 <- extract_info(lib2, names[2])
  df3 <- if (!is.null(lib3)) extract_info(lib3, names[3]) else NULL

  # --- merge stepwise by Formula ---
  merged12 <- merge(df1, df2, by = "Formula", all = TRUE)
  merged <- if (!is.null(df3)) merge(merged12, df3, by = "Formula", all = TRUE) else merged12

  # --- presence flags ---
  merged[[names[1]]] <- !is.na(merged[[paste0("Name_", names[1])]])
  merged[[names[2]]] <- !is.na(merged[[paste0("Name_", names[2])]])
  if (!is.null(df3)) merged[[names[3]]] <- !is.na(merged[[paste0("Name_", names[3])]])

  # --- keep only overlaps (≥2 libraries) ---
  presence_cols <- names[names %in% names(merged)]
  merged$num_present <- rowSums(merged[presence_cols])
  merged <- merged[merged$num_present >= 2, ]

  # --- classify overlap ---
  merged$Match_type <- ifelse(merged$num_present == 3, "3-way_overlap", "2-way_overlap")

  merged
}



```

### plot 3 libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(UpSetR)


plot_library_overlap_3lib <- function(compare_peaks_3lib,
                                      save_prefix = "library_overlap_3lib",
                                      mz_round = 3,
                                      save_csv = FALSE,
                                      width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300) {


  # ---- Summary data frame ----
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Compound = compare_peaks_3lib$Name_Inhouse,
    unique_in = compare_peaks_3lib$Unique_Inhouse,
    unique_mo = compare_peaks_3lib$Unique_MoNA,
    unique_csu = compare_peaks_3lib$Unique_CSU_PMF,
    overlap_in_mo = compare_peaks_3lib$Overlap_in_mo,
    overlap_in_csu = compare_peaks_3lib$Overlap_in_csu,
    overlap_mo_csu = compare_peaks_3lib$Overlap_mo_csu,
    overlap_3way = compare_peaks_3lib$Overlap_3way,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(total_peaks = unique_in + unique_mo + unique_csu +
             overlap_in_mo + overlap_in_csu + overlap_mo_csu + overlap_3way)

  # ---- Stacked bar plot ----
  long_df <- summary_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(unique_in, unique_mo, unique_csu,
               overlap_in_mo, overlap_in_csu, overlap_mo_csu, overlap_3way),
      names_to = "Type", values_to = "Count"
    )

  color_map <- c(
    "unique_in" = "#F28E2B",
    "unique_mo" = "#E15759",
    "unique_csu" = "#76B7B2",
    "overlap_in_mo" = "#59A14F",
    "overlap_in_csu" = "#8CD17D",
    "overlap_mo_csu" = "#B6992D",
    "overlap_3way" = "#4E79A7"
  )

  label_map <- c(
    "unique_in" = "Unique (Inhouse)",
    "unique_mo" = "Unique (MoNA)",
    "unique_csu" = "Unique (CSU_PMF)",
    "overlap_in_mo" = "Inhouse–MoNA",
    "overlap_in_csu" = "Inhouse–CSU_PMF",
    "overlap_mo_csu" = "MoNA–CSU_PMF",
    "overlap_3way" = "All three"
  )

# p_bar <- ggplot(
#   long_df %>%
#     mutate(Compound = factor(Compound, levels = unique(summary_df$Compound))),
#   aes(x = Compound, y = Count, fill = Type)
# ) +
#   geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
#   scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, labels = label_map) +
#   labs(
#     y = "Peak count", x = "Compound", fill = ""
#     # title = "Peak Overlap Between Inhouse, MoNA, and CSU_PMF Libraries"
#   ) +
#   theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
#   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
p_bar <- ggplot(
  long_df %>%
    mutate(Compound = factor(Compound, levels = unique(summary_df$Compound))),
  aes(x = Compound, y = Count, fill = Type)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, labels = label_map) +
  labs(
    y = "Peak count",
    x = "Compound",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 6, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7)
  )


  # ---- Build detailed peak-level table ----
  message("Building detailed peak-level overlap data...")

  make_peak_df_3lib <- function(names_vec,
                                list_in, list_mo, list_csu,
                                list_in_mo, list_in_csu, list_mo_csu,
                                list_all3) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(names_vec), function(i) {
      data.frame(
        Compound = names_vec[i],
        mz = c(
          list_in[[i]], list_mo[[i]], list_csu[[i]],
          list_in_mo[[i]], list_in_csu[[i]], list_mo_csu[[i]], list_all3[[i]]
        ),
        source_list = c(
          rep("mz_inhouse_only", length(list_in[[i]])),
          rep("mz_mona_only", length(list_mo[[i]])),
          rep("mz_csu_only", length(list_csu[[i]])),
          rep("mz_overlap_in_mo", length(list_in_mo[[i]])),
          rep("mz_overlap_in_csu", length(list_in_csu[[i]])),
          rep("mz_overlap_mo_csu", length(list_mo_csu[[i]])),
          rep("mz_overlap_3way", length(list_all3[[i]]))
        ),
        Inhouse = c(
          rep(1, length(list_in[[i]])), rep(0, length(list_mo[[i]])),
          rep(0, length(list_csu[[i]])), rep(1, length(list_in_mo[[i]])),
          rep(1, length(list_in_csu[[i]])), rep(0, length(list_mo_csu[[i]])),
          rep(1, length(list_all3[[i]]))
        ),
        MoNA = c(
          rep(0, length(list_in[[i]])), rep(1, length(list_mo[[i]])),
          rep(0, length(list_csu[[i]])), rep(1, length(list_in_mo[[i]])),
          rep(0, length(list_in_csu[[i]])), rep(1, length(list_mo_csu[[i]])),
          rep(1, length(list_all3[[i]]))
        ),
        CSU_PMF = c(
          rep(0, length(list_in[[i]])), rep(0, length(list_mo[[i]])),
          rep(1, length(list_csu[[i]])), rep(0, length(list_in_mo[[i]])),
          rep(1, length(list_in_csu[[i]])), rep(1, length(list_mo_csu[[i]])),
          rep(1, length(list_all3[[i]]))
        )
      )
    }))
  }

  peaks_all <- make_peak_df_3lib(
    compare_peaks_3lib$Name_Inhouse,
    compare_peaks_3lib$mz_inhouse_only,
    compare_peaks_3lib$mz_mona_only,
    compare_peaks_3lib$mz_csu_only,
    compare_peaks_3lib$mz_overlap_in_mo,
    compare_peaks_3lib$mz_overlap_in_csu,
    compare_peaks_3lib$mz_overlap_mo_csu,
    compare_peaks_3lib$mz_overlap_3way
  ) %>%
    mutate(mz_rounded = round(mz, mz_round)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mz))

  # ---- Category ----
  peaks_all <- peaks_all %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        Inhouse == 1 & MoNA == 0 & CSU_PMF == 0 ~ "Inhouse only",
        Inhouse == 0 & MoNA == 1 & CSU_PMF == 0 ~ "MoNA only",
        Inhouse == 0 & MoNA == 0 & CSU_PMF == 1 ~ "CSU_PMF only",
        Inhouse == 1 & MoNA == 1 & CSU_PMF == 0 ~ "Inhouse ∩ MoNA",
        Inhouse == 1 & MoNA == 0 & CSU_PMF == 1 ~ "Inhouse ∩ CSU_PMF",
        Inhouse == 0 & MoNA == 1 & CSU_PMF == 1 ~ "MoNA ∩ CSU_PMF",
        Inhouse == 1 & MoNA == 1 & CSU_PMF == 1 ~ "All three",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    )

  if (save_csv) {
    write.csv(peaks_all,
              paste0(save_prefix, "_peak_overlap_detailed.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    message("Saved detailed peak table: ",
            paste0(save_prefix, "_peak_overlap_detailed.csv"))
  }

  # ----  Global UpSet plot ----
  message("Creating UpSet plot...")

  upset_df <- data.frame(
    Inhouse = as.integer(peaks_all$Inhouse),
    MoNA    = as.integer(peaks_all$MoNA),
    CSU_PMF = as.integer(peaks_all$CSU_PMF)
  )
  upset_df <- upset_df[complete.cases(upset_df), ]



  # ----  Global UpSet plot ----
  message("Creating UpSet plot...")

  upset_df <- data.frame(
    Inhouse = as.integer(peaks_all$Inhouse),
    MoNA    = as.integer(peaks_all$MoNA),
    CSU_PMF = as.integer(peaks_all$CSU_PMF)
  )
  upset_df <- upset_df[complete.cases(upset_df), ]


message("Creating UpSet plot...")

# Prepare UpSet input
upset_df <- peaks_all %>%
  dplyr::select(Inhouse, MoNA, CSU_PMF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), as.integer)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()




upset_plot <- function() {
  UpSetR::upset(
    upset_df,
    sets = c("CSU_PMF", "Inhouse", "MoNA"),
    keep.order = TRUE,
    order.by = "freq",
    main.bar.color = "#4E79A7",
    sets.bar.color = "#F28E2B",
    nintersects = NA,

    show.numbers = "no",   # <- only removes those labels
    text.scale = 0.85,

    mainbar.y.label = "Number of shared peaks",
    sets.x.label = "Total peak count per library"
  )
}


# upset_plot <- function() {
  #   UpSetR::upset(
  #     upset_df,
  #     sets = c("CSU_PMF", "Inhouse", "MoNA"),
  #     keep.order = TRUE,
  #     order.by = "freq",
  #     main.bar.color = "#4E79A7",   # blue intersections
  #     sets.bar.color = "#F28E2B",   # orange side bars

  #     mainbar.y.label = "Number of shared m/z peaks (all compounds)",
  #     sets.x.label = "Total peak count per library"
  #   )
  # }
  # 


  # ---- Numeric summary ----
  intersection_summary <- peaks_all %>%
    group_by(Inhouse, MoNA, CSU_PMF) %>%
    summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Intersection = case_when(
        Inhouse == 1 & MoNA == 0 & CSU_PMF == 0 ~ "Inhouse only",
        Inhouse == 0 & MoNA == 1 & CSU_PMF == 0 ~ "MoNA only",
        Inhouse == 0 & MoNA == 0 & CSU_PMF == 1 ~ "CSU_PMF only",
        Inhouse == 1 & MoNA == 1 & CSU_PMF == 0 ~ "Inhouse ∩ MoNA",
        Inhouse == 1 & MoNA == 0 & CSU_PMF == 1 ~ "Inhouse ∩ CSU_PMF",
        Inhouse == 0 & MoNA == 1 & CSU_PMF == 1 ~ "MoNA ∩ CSU_PMF",
        Inhouse == 1 & MoNA == 1 & CSU_PMF == 1 ~ "All three",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Count))

  if (save_csv) {
    write.csv(intersection_summary,
              paste0(save_prefix, "_upset_intersection_summary.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    message("Saved intersection summary: ",
            paste0(save_prefix, "_upset_intersection_summary.csv"))
  }

message("Created summary bar plot, UpSet plot, and detailed peak table.")

# --- RETURN ---
invisible(list(
  summary_df = summary_df,
  barplot = p_bar,
  upsetplot = upset_plot,    
  upset_df = upset_df,
  peaks_table = peaks_all,
  intersection_summary = intersection_summary
))


}
```

```{r}
library(grid)
library(UpSetR)

shrink_bar_numbers <- function(gr, new_fontsize = 6, big_fs_threshold = 10) {

  if (inherits(gr, "text")) {
    lab <- gr$label


    fs <- NA_real_
    if (!is.null(gr$gp) && !is.null(gr$gp$fontsize)) fs <- gr$gp$fontsize

    # labels may be vector; we only want pure integers
    is_num <- rep(FALSE, length(lab))
    if (is.character(lab)) {
      is_num <- grepl("^[0-9]+$", lab)
    }


    if (any(is_num) && !is.na(fs) && fs >= big_fs_threshold) {
      gr$gp$fontsize <- new_fontsize
    }

    return(gr)
  }


  if (!is.null(gr$grobs)) {
    gr$grobs <- lapply(gr$grobs, shrink_bar_numbers,
                       new_fontsize = new_fontsize,
                       big_fs_threshold = big_fs_threshold)
  }
  if (!is.null(gr$children)) {
    gr$children <- lapply(gr$children, shrink_bar_numbers,
                          new_fontsize = new_fontsize,
                          big_fs_threshold = big_fs_threshold)
  }

  gr
}

g2 <- shrink_bar_numbers(g, new_fontsize = 6, big_fs_threshold = 10)


png("upset_small_numbers.png", width = 8.9, height = 7.5, units = "cm", res = 600)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g2)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
summarize_peak_mz_all_libs <- function(in_house_list,
                                       mona_lib_list,
                                       csu_lib_list,
                                       overlaps_df) {

  safe_summary <- function(lib, lib_name) {
    df <- summarize_peak_mz_cpp(lib)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      message("No peaks found for ", lib_name)
      df <- data.frame(Compound = character())
    }
    df
  }

  in_summary  <- safe_summary(in_house_list, "Inhouse")
  mo_summary  <- safe_summary(mona_lib_list, "MoNA")
  csu_summary <- safe_summary(csu_lib_list, "CSU_PMF")

  in_summary  <- in_summary  %>% rename(Name_Inhouse = Compound)
  mo_summary  <- mo_summary  %>% rename(Name_MoNA = Compound)
  csu_summary <- csu_summary %>% rename(Name_CSU_PMF = Compound)

  merged <- overlaps_df %>%
    left_join(in_summary,  by = "Name_Inhouse",  suffix = c("", "_Inhouse")) %>%
    left_join(mo_summary,  by = "Name_MoNA",     suffix = c("", "_MoNA")) %>%
    left_join(csu_summary, by = "Name_CSU_PMF",  suffix = c("", "_CSU_PMF"))

  return(merged)
}
```

```{r}
summarize_peak_mz_all_libs <- function(in_summary,
                                       mo_summary,
                                       csu_summary,
                                       overlaps_df) {

  # rename safely using base R
  names(in_summary)[names(in_summary) == "Compound"] <- "Name_Inhouse"
  names(mo_summary)[names(mo_summary) == "Compound"] <- "Name_MoNA"
  names(csu_summary)[names(csu_summary) == "Compound"] <- "Name_CSU_PMF"

  # perform joins
  merged <- overlaps_df %>%
    left_join(in_summary,  by = "Name_Inhouse",  suffix = c("", "_Inhouse")) %>%
    left_join(mo_summary,  by = "Name_MoNA",     suffix = c("", "_MoNA")) %>%
    left_join(csu_summary, by = "Name_CSU_PMF",  suffix = c("", "_CSU_PMF"))

  return(merged)
}
```

## bar plot and box plot for all compound in the library


```{r}
plot_peak_distribution_all_libs <- function(summary_df,
                                            lib_name = "Library",
                                            save_prefix = NULL,
                                            show_x_labels = TRUE,
                                            show_total_labels = FALSE) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)

  # --- Detect compound name column automatically ---
  compound_col <- intersect(c("Compound", "Name_Inhouse", "Name", "Compound_name"), names(summary_df))
  if (length(compound_col) == 0)
    stop("no compound name column found (expected one of: Compound, Name_Inhouse, Name, Compound_name)")
  compound_col <- compound_col[1]

  # --- Flexible column detection ---
  n_leq_col <- grep("n_smaller", names(summary_df), value = TRUE)
  n_gt_col <- grep("n_bigger", names(summary_df), value = TRUE)
  n_total_col <- grep("n_total", names(summary_df), value = TRUE)

  if (length(c(n_leq_col, n_gt_col)) == 0)
    stop("No 'n_smaller' or 'n_bigger' columns found — please check your input.")

  # --- Long format for all libraries ---
  plot_df <- summary_df %>%
    select(Compound = all_of(compound_col),
           all_of(c(n_leq_col, n_gt_col, n_total_col))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("n_smaller|n_bigger"),
      names_to = "Lib_Region",
      values_to = "Count"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Library = case_when(
        grepl("_MoNA", Lib_Region, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "MoNA",
        grepl("_CSU_PMF", Lib_Region, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "CSU–PMF",
        TRUE ~ lib_name
      ),
      Region = case_when(
        grepl("smaller", Lib_Region, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "≤ [M+Na]+",
        grepl("bigger", Lib_Region, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "> [M+Na]+"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(Compound, Library, Region) %>%
    summarise(Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Compound, Library) %>%
    mutate(
      n_total = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
      Percent = 100 * Count / n_total
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # --- Order compounds by mean above/below balance ---
  order_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(Compound) %>%
    summarise(mean_above = mean(Percent[Region == "> [M+Na]+"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(mean_above)
  plot_df$Compound <- factor(plot_df$Compound, levels = order_df$Compound)


  # --- Barplot ---
  barplot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Compound, y = Percent, fill = Region)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ Library, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("≤ [M+Na]+" = "#4E79A7", "> [M+Na]+" = "#E15759")
    ) +
    labs(
    #  title = paste("Peak Distribution Relative to [M+Na]+ —", lib_name),
      x = "Compound",
      y = "Percentage of Peaks",
      fill = "Region"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = if (show_x_labels)
        element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10, face = "italic")
      else
        element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = if (show_x_labels) element_line() else element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "gray50"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  # --- Optionally show total counts ---
  if (show_total_labels) {
    barplot <- barplot +
      geom_text(
        data = plot_df %>% distinct(Compound, Library, n_total),
        aes(x = Compound, y = 105, label = paste0("n=", n_total)),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 3,
        vjust = 0,
        color = "black",
        fontface = "italic"
      )
  }

  # --- Summary statistics per library ---
  summary_stats <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(Library, Region) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pct = mean(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct = median(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_pct = sd(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- Save results if requested ---
  if (!is.null(save_prefix)) {
    ggsave(paste0(save_prefix, "_barplot.png"), barplot, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
    write.csv(summary_stats, paste0(save_prefix, "_summary_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  list(
    barplot = barplot,
    summary_stats = summary_stats,
    data = plot_df
  )
}


```

```{r}
# Build a mapping dataframe from your overlap info
name_map <- library_3_overlap_unique %>%
  dplyr::select(Name_Inhouse, Name_MoNA, Name_CSU_PMF) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Name_MoNA, Name_CSU_PMF),
    names_to = "Source",
    values_to = "OldName"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(NewName = Name_Inhouse) %>%
  dplyr::select(OldName, NewName) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Helper to replace names
unify_names <- function(df, column = "Compound", map_df) {
  col_sym <- rlang::sym(column)
  df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(map_df, by = setNames("OldName", column)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Compound = ifelse(!is.na(NewName), NewName, !!col_sym)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-NewName)
}
```

### bind rows of the 3 library

```{r}
harmonize_compound_names <- function(df, lib_name, name_map) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Library = lib_name,
           Compound = as.character(Compound))

  if (lib_name == "Inhouse") {
    # Inhouse names are already canonical — just keep them
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(Compound = as.character(Compound))

  } else if (lib_name == "MoNA") {
    df <- df %>%
      left_join(name_map, by = c("Compound" = "Name_MoNA")) %>%
      mutate(
        Compound = dplyr::coalesce(Name_Inhouse, Compound)
      ) %>%
      select(-starts_with("Name_"))

  } else if (lib_name == "CSU_PMF") {
    df <- df %>%
      left_join(name_map, by = c("Compound" = "Name_CSU_PMF")) %>%
      mutate(
        Compound = dplyr::coalesce(Name_Inhouse, Compound)
      ) %>%
      select(-starts_with("Name_"))
  }

  # Optional: warn if any remain unmapped
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(df$Compound))
  if (n_missing > 0) {
    warning(sprintf("[%s] %d compounds have no Inhouse mapping.", lib_name, n_missing))
  }

  return(df)
}

# name map
name_map <- library_3_overlap_unique %>%
  select(Name_Inhouse, Name_MoNA, Name_CSU_PMF)

# harmonize each dataset
inhouse_df <- harmonize_compound_names(inhouse_plot_shared$data, "Inhouse", name_map)
mona_df    <- harmonize_compound_names(mona_plot_shared$data, "MoNA", name_map)
csu_df     <- harmonize_compound_names(csu_plot_shared$data, "CSU_PMF", name_map)

# combine
combined_shared_df <- bind_rows(inhouse_df, mona_df, csu_df)



combined_shared_df
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plot_each_compound <- function(df, save_dir = NULL) {
  # ensure output directory if saving
  if (!is.null(save_dir) && !dir.exists(save_dir)) {
    dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  unique_compounds <- unique(df$Compound)

  for (cmpd in unique_compounds) {
    sub_df <- df %>% filter(Compound == cmpd)

    p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = Library, y = Percent, fill = Region)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "#4E79A7", "pct_above" = "#E15759"),
        labels = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "≤ PI m/z", "pct_above" = "> PI m/z")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Peak Distribution Comparison —", cmpd),
        subtitle = paste("Across Libraries:", paste(unique(sub_df$Library), collapse = ", ")),
        x = "Library",
        y = "Percentage of Peaks",
        fill = "Region"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )

    print(p)  # show in viewer

    if (!is.null(save_dir)) {
      filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cmpd), "_comparison.png"))
      ggsave(filename, p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
plot_each_compound_bar <- function(df,
                                   save_dir = NULL,
                                   show_total_labels = TRUE,
                                   label_position = c("above", "inside")) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)

  label_position <- match.arg(label_position)

  if (!is.null(save_dir) && !dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  unique_compounds <- unique(df$Compound)

  for (cmpd in unique_compounds) {
    sub_df <- df %>% filter(Compound == cmpd)

    # One total n per Library
    totals <- sub_df %>%
      distinct(Library, n_total)

    # Base plot
    p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = Library, y = Percent, fill = Region)) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "#4E79A7", "pct_above" = "#E15759"),
        labels = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "≤ PI m/z", "pct_above" = "> PI m/z")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Peak Distribution —", cmpd),
        x = "Library",
        y = "Percentage of Peaks",
        fill = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )

    # Add total n labels if requested
    if (show_total_labels) {
      if (label_position == "above") {
        p <- p +
          geom_text(
            data = totals,
            aes(x = Library, y = 105, label = paste0("n=", n_total)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = 0,
            size = 3,
            fontface = "italic"
          )
      } else if (label_position == "inside") {
        p <- p +
          geom_text(
            data = totals,
            aes(x = Library, y = 50, label = paste0("n=", n_total)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "white",
            size = 3,
            fontface = "bold"
          )
      }
    }

    print(p)

    if (!is.null(save_dir)) {
      filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cmpd), "_bar.png"))
      ggsave(filename, p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
plot_each_compound_bar <- function(df,
                                   save_dir = NULL,
                                   show_total_labels = TRUE,
                                   label_position = c("above", "inside")) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)

  label_position <- match.arg(label_position)

  if (!is.null(save_dir) && !dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  unique_compounds <- unique(df$Compound)

  for (cmpd in unique_compounds) {
    sub_df <- df %>% filter(Compound == cmpd)

    # one total n per library
    totals <- sub_df %>%
      distinct(Library, n_total)

    p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = Library, y = Percent, fill = Region)) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "#4E79A7", "pct_above" = "#E15759"),
        labels = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "≤ PI m/z", "pct_above" = "> PI m/z")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Peak Distribution —", cmpd),
        x = "Library",
        y = "Percentage of Peaks",
        fill = "Region"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )

    # n labels
    if (show_total_labels) {
      label_y <- if (label_position == "above") 105 else 50
      label_color <- if (label_position == "inside") "white" else "black"
      vjust_val <- if (label_position == "above") 0 else 1.5

      p <- p +
        geom_text(
          data = totals,
          aes(x = Library, y = label_y, label = paste0("n=", n_total)),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          color = label_color,
          size = 3,
          fontface = "italic",
          vjust = vjust_val
        )
    }

    print(p)

    if (!is.null(save_dir)) {
      filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cmpd), "_bar.png"))
      ggsave(filename, p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
    }
  }
}

```


```{r}
plot_each_compound_bar(
  combined_shared_df,
  label_position = "above",
  show_total_labels = TRUE
)
```
